records.jp: もう、いい加減にして
records.en_original: I know you're here. Stop this.
records.en_auxiliary: I know you're here. Stop this.
records.en: Enough already.

records.jp: 勇希、出てきて
records.en_original: Come out, Yuki.
records.en_auxiliary: Come out, Yuki.
records.en: Come out, Yuki.

records.jp: 全部、教えて。<CR>もう嘘は無しだよ
records.en_original: Tell me everything. No more lies.
records.en_auxiliary: Tell me everything. No more lies.
records.en: Tell me everything.<CR>No more lies.

records.jp: …………あたしの灰病は、治らなかった
records.en_original: I never recovered from Ash Syndrome.
records.en_auxiliary: I never recovered from Ash Syndrome.
records.en: My Ash Syndrome was never cured.

records.jp: あたしは施設に移されて間もなく、死んだ
records.en_original: Not long after I moved to the next facility, I died.
records.en_auxiliary: Not long after I moved to the next facility, I died.
records.en: I died not long after I was moved to the facility.

records.jp: でも、突然目が覚めた
records.en_original: Then, I opened my eyes.
records.en_auxiliary: Then, I opened my eyes.
records.en: But then I suddenly woke up.

records.en_original: What...?
records.en_auxiliary: What...?
records.en: What...?

records.jp: 死んだはずのあたしは、<CR>真っ暗な空間で目覚めた
records.en_original: I should've been dead, but I woke up in darkness.
records.en_auxiliary: I should've been dead, but I woke up in darkness.
records.en: I should have been dead,<CR>but I woke up in a pitch-dark space.

records.jp: そこには、何かがいた
records.en_original: And there was something there.
records.en_auxiliary: And there was something there.
records.en: Something was there.

records.jp: あれは、神様だった
records.en_original: It was a god.
records.en_auxiliary: It was a god.
records.en: It was a god.

records.jp: そこにあったのか、具体的には言い表せない……<CR>でも、確かに神がいる、と思った
records.en_original: I don't know exactly what it was, but that's what I remember thinking.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know exactly what it was, but that's what I remember thinking.
records.en: I can't describe exactly what was there...<CR>But I was certain there was a god.

records.jp: そして神は、あたしの魂の形を変えた
records.en_original: And this god took my soul and changed it.
records.en_auxiliary: And this god took my soul and changed it.
records.en: And that god changed the shape of my soul.

records.jp: 魂の形を、変えた……？
records.en_original: It changed you...?
records.en_auxiliary: It changed you...?
records.en: Changed the shape of your soul...?

records.jp: あたしの存在は作り変えられた。<CR>そして……あたしは、世界システムの一部になった
records.en_original: I was completely remade. And I...became a part of the World System.
records.en_auxiliary: I was completely remade. And I...became a part of the World System.
records.en: My very existence was remade.<CR>And... I became part of the World System.

records.jp: だから……どれだけ逃げても、隠れても無駄なんだよ
records.en_original: That's why... It's useless. No matter how much you run or hide.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why... It's useless. No matter how much you run or hide.
records.en: So... no matter how far you run or where you hide, it's pointless.

records.jp: あたしがいる限り、<CR>この世界の場所は筒抜けなんだから
records.en_original: As long as I'm here, it knows exactly where you are.
records.en_auxiliary: As long as I'm here, it knows exactly where you are.
records.en: As long as I'm here,<CR>the location of this world is completely exposed.

records.en_original: No...
records.en_auxiliary: No...
records.en: You're lying...?

records.jp: 勇希が、世界システムの一部…………？
records.en_original: Yuki is a part of the World System...?
records.en_auxiliary: Yuki is a part of the World System...?
records.en: Yuki is a part of the World System...?

records.jp: 金城さんは敵だってことですか……！？
records.en_original: So Yuki was our enemy all along?!
records.en_auxiliary: So Yuki was our enemy all along?!
records.en: Does that mean Kinjou-san is an enemy...?!

records.jp: でも、そんなそぶりは一度も――
records.en_original: But she always acted like one of us—
records.en_auxiliary: But she always acted like one of us—
records.en: But she never showed any sign of that—

records.jp: そりゃそうだよ。だって、あたし自身忘れてたからね
records.en_original: Of course. Because I had forgotten my true self.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course. Because I had forgotten my true self.
records.en: Of course. I'd forgotten it myself.

records.jp: でも、忘れてた間も<CR>システムの一部であることは変わらない
records.en_original: But forgetting didn't make me any less a part of the System.
records.en_auxiliary: But forgetting didn't make me any less a part of the System.
records.en: But even while I'd forgotten,<CR>I was still part of the System.

records.jp: あたしは……みんなと一緒に過ごしながら、<CR>ここだよって場所を伝えてたんだよ。知らないうちにね
records.en_original: I didn't realize it, but I was the beacon that led them straight to us.
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't realize it, but I was the beacon that led them straight to us.
records.en: I spent all that time with everyone<CR>broadcasting, 'We're here.' I didn't even know it.

records.en_original: That can't be...
records.en_auxiliary: That can't be...
records.en: That can't be...

records.jp: な、なんで世界システムは、<CR>そんなことしたんですか…………！？
records.en_original: W-why would the World System do such a thing?!
records.en_auxiliary: W-why would the World System do such a thing?!
records.en: W-why would the World System<CR>do something like that...?!

records.jp: さあ？　あたしは神の考えることなんて分かんない
records.en_original: Who knows? How can I possibly understand how god thinks.
records.en_auxiliary: Who knows? How can I possibly understand how god thinks.
records.en: Who knows? I have no idea what a god thinks.

records.jp: でも、きっとみんなが目障りだったんでしょ？
records.en_original: All I know is that you're nothing more than an obstacle to them.
records.en_auxiliary: All I know is that you're nothing more than an obstacle to them.
records.en: But I guess all of you were an eyesore, right?

records.jp: 世界システムは、この世界を初期化した。<CR>すべてを無に還す――その予定だった
records.en_original: TheWorld System reset the world. Nothing was supposed to be left behind.
records.en_auxiliary: TheWorld System reset the world. Nothing was supposed to be left behind.
records.en: The World System reset this world.<CR>It intended to return everything to nothing.

records.jp: でもそれは、99％のところで止まった。<CR>雫世界が生まれたから
records.en_original: But the process is stuck at 99%... All because of the creation of Oasis.
records.en_auxiliary: But the process is stuck at 99%... All because of the creation of Oasis.
records.en: But the process stopped at 99 percent<CR>because Oasis was born.

records.jp: だから、「目」を送り込んだ。<CR>確実にこの世界を破壊するために
records.en_original: That's why it appointed someone to be its eyes. In order to ensure the destruction of this world.
records.en_auxiliary: That's why it appointed someone to be its eyes. In order to ensure the destruction of this world.
records.en: So it sent in an 'eye'<CR>to make certain this world was destroyed.

records.jp: 目……そうか、<CR>だから消滅機構は正確に私たちを狙って――
records.en_original: Their eyes... So that's why they kept coming after us...
records.en_auxiliary: Their eyes... So that's why they kept coming after us...
records.en: An eye... I see.<CR>That's why the erasure mechanism could target us so precisely—

records.jp: その目的を遂行するため、<CR>世界システムから送り込まれた消滅機構
records.en_original: To accomplish this, the World System sent an anti-virus to delete us.
records.en_auxiliary: To accomplish this, the World System sent an anti-virus to delete us.
records.en: An erasure mechanism sent by the World System<CR>to carry out that purpose.

records.jp: それこそが、あの敵の正体だ
records.en_original: That is the enemy we are dealing with.
records.en_auxiliary: That is the enemy we are dealing with.
records.en: That is what the enemy truly is.

records.jp: …………ふざけるな
records.en_original: ...You've got to be joking.
records.en_auxiliary: ...You've got to be joking.
records.en: ...You've got to be kidding me.

records.jp: なんだよ、それ！！<CR>せっかく……せっかく、この世界で、会えたのに……
records.en_original: How could this happen?! After all we went through, I finally had you back!
records.en_auxiliary: How could this happen?! After all we went through, I finally had you back!
records.en: What the hell is that?!<CR>We finally... finally got to meet again in this world...

records.jp: なんでそんなことになってるんだよ！！
records.en_original: And this is how things end?!
records.en_auxiliary: And this is how things end?!
records.en: Why did things have to turn out like this?!

records.jp: ねえ、答えてよ勇希！！
records.en_original: Tell me, Yuki!
records.en_auxiliary: Tell me, Yuki!
records.en: Answer me, Yuki!!

records.jp: これまで一緒にやってきたことも……<CR>楽しかった思い出も――
records.en_original: All that time we spent together, the memories we made...
records.en_auxiliary: All that time we spent together, the memories we made...
records.en: Everything we've done together...<CR>all the happy memories—

records.jp: 全部、全部嘘だったってこと！？
records.en_original: Were those all lies, too?!
records.en_auxiliary: Were those all lies, too?!
records.en: Were they all—every last one of them—lies?!

records.jp: クソッ、逃げるな勇希！！
records.en_original: Damn it, stop running away from me, Yuki!
records.en_auxiliary: Damn it, stop running away from me, Yuki!
records.en: Damn it, stop running, Yuki!!

records.jp: ダメ、伶那さんっ！！
records.en_original: Rena, no!
records.en_auxiliary: Rena, no!
records.en: No, Rena-san!!

records.jp: あいつを、倒さないと
records.en_original: We have to beat this thing first!
records.en_auxiliary: We have to beat this thing first!
records.en: We have to defeat it first.

records.jp: …………もう、我慢ならない
records.en_original: ...I've had enough of this.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I've had enough of this.
records.en: ...I've had enough of this.

records.jp: 一発、ひっぱたいてやるっ！！
records.en_original: I'll make this quick!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll make this quick!
records.en: I'm going to give her a good slap!!
